location.description: The location of the Backend that this Domain is associated with
location.rationale: Location inherits from backend configuration and has no independent security policy.

backend.description: The ID of the Backend that this Domain is associated with
backend.rationale: Backend ID is a reference with no direct security implications.

domain_id.description: Id of the domain to create. Must be a valid domain name, such as "foo.com"
domain_id.rationale: Custom domain ID has no specific security policy.

serve.description: The serving behavior of the domain. If specified, the domain will serve content other than its Backend's live content. Structure is [documented below](#nested_serve).
serve.rationale: Domain serving behavior has no specific security policy.

redirect.description: Specifies redirect behavior for a domain. Structure is [documented below](#nested_serve_redirect).
redirect.rationale: Domain redirect configuration has no specific security policy.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Project specification uses default provider project when not specified.

redirect.rationale: Redirect configuration has no specific security policy.

uri.description: The URI of the redirect's intended destination. This URI will be prepended to the original request path. URI without a scheme are assumed to be HTTPS.
uri.rationale: Redirect URI has no specific security policy.

status.description: The status code to use in a redirect response. Must be a valid HTTP 3XX status code. Defaults to 302 if not present.
status.rationale: Redirect status code has no specific security policy.
